notes: World consumption by product, 2025 (EIA, eia-intl): distillate fuel oil 29.1 mb/d, motor gasoline 27.9 mb/d, jet fuel 7.3 mb/d, residual fuel oil 6.3 mb/d. The four products do not add up to total oil demand: the other liquids are not listed.
EIA refined-product production series end in 2014 and are not used; no production table.

Russia: the exports above rest on what importers declare (see the note on Russia). The U.S. Energy Information Administration (Country Analysis Brief: Russia, last updated 24 July 2025, public domain, https://www.eia.gov/international/analysis/country/RUS) puts Russia as the world's fourth-largest petroleum product exporter in 2023, with 1.9 million b/d, and says that in 2024 Türkiye received 17% of Russia's product exports, China 11%, and Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, India and Brazil 8% each. The units differ, so no ratio is computed. The Atlas customs extract holds no flow of 1,000 t or more (and 1 million USD or more) from Russia to the United Arab Emirates in 2024 (1.22 Mt in 2023); smaller flows are not in the extract.
